meta.title: Request a quote
meta.description: Get a fixed price for window cleaning, stairwells, post-construction or retail cleaning. Answer within one working day.

quote.title: Request a quote
quote.text: Some services are priced after a short walkthrough, because the work differs too much between premises. Describe what you need and we come back with a fixed price within one working day.
quote.descriptionHelp: Number of windows, floors, how often, any special requirements. The more you write, the more exact the quote.
quote.successTitle: Thank you, we have your request!
quote.successText: We will read it through and come back with a fixed price within one working day.

meta.title: Contact us
meta.description: Call, email or leave your number and we get back to you. We clean across Västra Götaland, Jönköping and Halland.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.text: Call if it is urgent, otherwise we answer email the same working day.
contact.hoursWeekend: Weekends: closed, but email is read

callback.title: Leave your number
callback.text: We call you back, usually within the hour during office hours.
callback.name: Name
callback.success: Thank you! We will call you shortly.
callback.error: Something went wrong. Please call us directly on {{phone}}.
